owner_text:
THE TOWN THAT STOLE EVERYONE’S TEARS
Genre: Supernatural Horror / Mystery / Emotional Drama
Format: In This Town – Roblox Cinematic Story
Language: English
Aspect Ratio: 9:16 Vertical
Target Duration: 1:10–1:20 each episode
Narration: First-person storytelling, with character dialogue
Ending: Emotional twist + meaningful message

CHARACTER DESIGN AND CONSISTENCY
IMPORTANT: Maintain the exact same character appearance, clothes, hair, body proportions, and accessories throughout both episodes.

1. LEO — Main Character
• Age: 12
• Black messy hair.
• Dark brown eyes.
• Red hoodie, black pants, white sneakers.
• Small scar above his left eyebrow.
• Personality: Brave but sensitive.
• Facial expressions: Curious, frightened, confused, crying, determined.

2. AVA — Leo’s Little Sister
• Age: 8
• Shoulder-length brown hair.
• Blue eyes.
• Yellow sweater, denim skirt, white shoes.
• Carries a small teddy bear.
• Personality: Innocent, emotional, easily frightened.

3. MAYOR BLACKWOOD — Main Antagonist
• Age: 55
• Gray slicked-back hair.
• Black suit, red tie.
• Pale face, dark tired eyes.
• Carries a golden pocket watch.
• Personality: Calm, manipulative, emotionally broken.
• Never smiles. His eyes should look exhausted rather than purely evil.

4. MOTHER — Elena
• Age: 35
• Long dark brown hair.
• Beige cardigan, white blouse.
• Gentle facial expressions.
• Looks exhausted and frightened in the tower.

5. THE TEAR COLLECTORS
• Tall guards wearing black uniforms.
• Featureless black masks with glowing red eye slits.
• Carry transparent glass containers.
• Move in synchronized, robotic movements.
• No dialogue. Only mechanical breathing.

WORLD DESIGN
Town: GRAYHAVEN
Visual identity:
• Old European-inspired town.
• Narrow cobblestone streets.
• Victorian-style houses.
• Black street lamps.
• Large clock tower in the town center.
• Constant gray fog.
• Muted colors, except red warning lights.

Important locations
1. Leo’s House: Small two-story house, old family photographs, warm interior lighting.
2. Town Square: Large public clock, warning sirens, citizens walking with emotionless faces.
3. School: Old school building, gray walls, fluorescent lights.
4. Clock Tower: Huge mechanical clock, underground laboratory, thousands of glass bottles containing glowing golden tears.
5. Underground Prison: Glass chambers where people who refuse to surrender their memories are kept.

PART 1 — THE FIRST TEAR
Estimated duration: 1:15

SCENE 1 — THE HOOK
TIME: 0:00–0:08

LOCATION: Grayhaven Town Square — Night.

CAMERA:
• Extreme close-up of a child’s eye.
• A tear slowly rolls down the cheek.
• Before it reaches the chin, a mechanical hand suddenly catches it inside a glass vial.
• Smash cut to a giant clock tower.
• Red warning lights flash across the entire town.

LIGHTING: Dark blue moonlight with intense red flashing lights.

SOUND: One loud alarm, followed by a heartbeat.

NARRATOR (LEO) — terrified, urgent, serious:
“In my town, crying is illegal. And yesterday, I watched the police arrest my eight-year-old sister… for shedding ONE tear.”

TRANSITION: Fast zoom into Leo’s frightened face.

SCENE 2 — THE LAW
TIME: 0:08–0:21

LOCATION: Grayhaven streets — Morning.

CAMERA:
• Wide aerial shot of the town.
• Citizens walking silently.
• A mother accidentally drops a photograph.
• Her eyes become watery, but she quickly wipes them.
• A Tear Collector turns its head toward her.

NARRATOR — calm but unsettling:
“Mayor Blackwood created this law ten years ago. Nobody was allowed to cry. Not at funerals. Not at hospitals. Not even when someone they loved disappeared.”

CUT TO: A large digital sign above the town square.

ON-SCREEN TEXT:
“LAW NO. 01: EVERY TEAR BELONGS TO THE MAYOR.”

CAMERA: Slow push toward the sign.

SOUND: Deep mechanical ticking.

SCENE 3 — THE FAMILY
TIME: 0:21–0:33

LOCATION: Leo’s bedroom — Evening.

LIGHTING: Warm yellow lamp, soft shadows.

CAMERA:
• Medium shot of Leo sitting beside Ava.
• Ava holds a teddy bear.
• An old photograph of their mother sits on the bedside table.
• Ava looks at the photograph with a confused expression.

AVA — innocent, quiet, sad:
“Leo… what did Mom’s voice sound like?”

LEO — surprised, trying to smile:
“You don’t remember?”

AVA — eyes beginning to water:
“I remember her face… but I can’t remember her voice.”

CAMERA: Extreme close-up of Leo’s face. His smile disappears.

NARRATOR — emotional, quiet:
“Our mother disappeared three years ago. And every month, Ava remembers a little less about her.”

SCENE 4 — THE ARREST
TIME: 0:33–0:47

LOCATION: Town Square — Next morning.

LIGHTING: Cold gray daylight.

CAMERA:
• Tracking shot following Ava and Leo walking through the square.
• Ava sees a little girl hugging her mother.
• She stops and looks at them.
• A tear falls from Ava’s right eye.

SOUND: Sudden silence.

SFX: RED WARNING SIREN.

ON-SCREEN TEXT:
“EMOTIONAL VIOLATION DETECTED.”

CAMERA:
• Two Tear Collectors turn simultaneously.
• Low-angle shot as they approach.
• One guard grabs Ava’s arm.

AVA — screaming, terrified:
“LEO! HELP ME!”

LEO — angry, desperate:
“LET HER GO! SHE’S JUST A CHILD!”

ACTION:
• Leo tries to pull Ava away.
• One guard pushes him to the ground.
• Ava is dragged toward a black vehicle.

SCENE 5 — THE DISCOVERY
TIME: 0:47–1:05

LOCATION: Clock Tower — Underground Laboratory, Night.

LIGHTING: Dark environment illuminated by thousands of glowing golden glass bottles.

CAMERA:
• Leo sneaks through a metal ventilation entrance.
• Over-the-shoulder shot as he looks down at a massive laboratory.
• Slow panoramic camera movement revealing thousands of bottles.
• Each bottle has a citizen’s name written on it.

NARRATOR — whispering, shocked:
“I followed the guards to the clock tower. But what I found underground was worse than prison. Every tear ever collected was stored inside a glass bottle.”

ACTION:
• Leo walks toward a shelf.
• He notices one bottle with a familiar name.
• Extreme close-up of its label.

ON-SCREEN LABEL:
“ELENA — LEO AND AVA’S MOTHER.”

LEO — whispering, trembling:
“Mom…?”

SCENE 6 — THE CLIFFHANGER
TIME: 1:05–1:16

LOCATION: Underground Laboratory — Same shelf.

CAMERA:
• Leo slowly picks up the bottle.
• Golden light reflects in his eyes.
• A faint woman’s voice comes from inside.

MOTHER — faint, emotional, desperate:
“Leo… if you can hear me… don’t let him take Ava’s memories too.”

CAMERA:
• Leo drops the bottle slightly but catches it.
• Behind him, a shadow appears.
• Slow camera rotation reveals Mayor Blackwood standing in the darkness.

MAYOR BLACKWOOD — calm, cold:
“You’re not supposed to be here, boy.”

CUT TO BLACK.

ON-SCREEN TEXT:
“WHAT IS THE MAYOR HIDING?”

END OF PART 1.

PART 2 — THE MAYOR’S SECRET
Estimated duration: 1:15

SCENE 1 — CAUGHT
TIME: 0:00–0:12

LOCATION: Underground Laboratory.

LIGHTING: Red emergency lights mixed with golden bottle reflections.

CAMERA:
• Start with a close-up of Mayor Blackwood’s eyes.
• Slowly pull back to reveal Leo holding his mother’s bottle.
• Two guards emerge behind Leo.

MAYOR BLACKWOOD — emotionless, intimidating:
“Put the bottle down, Leo.”

LEO — frightened but determined:
“Where is my mother? What did you do to her?”

MAYOR — slowly approaching:
“I protected this town from something far worse than sadness.”

SOUND: Deep cinematic bass.

SCENE 2 — THE SECRET
TIME: 0:12–0:29

LOCATION: Mayor’s private chamber inside the clock tower.

LIGHTING: Dim golden light. A single spotlight illuminates an old photograph of a little girl.

CAMERA:
• Mayor walks toward the photograph.
• Close-up of his trembling hand touching the frame.
• Flashback transition with a warm, desaturated filter.

NARRATOR — confused, slowly understanding:
“Then I saw her photograph. The mayor had a daughter. She died ten years ago. After that, he couldn’t stop crying.”

FLASHBACK:
• A younger Mayor kneels beside his sick daughter’s hospital bed.
• The little girl holds his hand.
• Her monitor slowly goes silent.
• The mayor breaks down crying.

MAYOR — voice breaking during the flashback:
“I just wanted to hear her voice one more time.”

SCENE 3 — THE REAL PURPOSE
TIME: 0:29–0:44
